executor_linux_aarch64.landlock: AVAILABLE — every required denial observed by the live probe (canary secret, home, /etc/passwd, all writes, TCP, UDP, unix socket, fork, signal to parent, 2 GiB allocation; empty environment; no inherited descriptor; wall and output bounds)
executor_linux_aarch64.bwrap: UNAVAILABLE — the probe worker did not run under this backend (rc 1, OK): bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR: Operation not permitted
executor_linux_aarch64.bwrap_gap: kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1 without an AppArmor profile for /usr/bin/bwrap; only the machine's administrator can change that; NOT done and not requested by the product
executor_linux_aarch64.also_verified_on: CPython 3.10.21 (uv-managed interpreter) and from both installed artifacts

hosted_linux_x86_64: UNVERIFIED — REMOTE_CI_NOT_RUN_FOR_NEW_SHA. The workflow prints the live probe; the x86-64 seccomp syscall table has never executed. If no backend passes there, the module tests and the package job FAIL (they are not skipped).
other_platforms: macOS, Windows, kernels without Landlock or working bubblewrap: SHD admission refuses with REFUSED_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE; every other function works
what_it_is_not: process confinement, not a container; no PID/mount namespace on the landlock backend; no defence against a kernel vulnerability or the same OS user outside the worker; no independent security review
